plan.function: record kind 'reveal', t0 = 2 (09:00): the plan adopted when the 09:00 forecast, tomorrow's site reserve and tomorrow's market state are revealed; later records are the 30-minute re-plans and are not used
plan.fcess_mw: record reg_raise, cont_raise, reg_lower, cont_lower (enabled MW)
plan.load_fc_mw: record 'load' / (1 + 0.16): the expected factory load (synthetic: example site × 10)
plan.meter_mw: derived: load_fc_mw − battery_mw (energy only; regulation's expected energy, 0.14 MWh per MW-h raise and 0.05 per MW-h lower, is not included)
plan.reserve_floor_mwh: derived: record 'hard' (compliance floor, 0 on m1) + (reg_raise + cont_raise) × 0.25 h / η, η = √0.85; the plan's own LP keeps s ≥ each of them
plan.site_reserve_floor_mwh: record soft floor 'site reserve: CMD and IRCR' (economic, end of half-hour)
plan.action: derived: 'pre' before 09:00; 'charge' if battery_mw < −0.001; 'shave' if battery_mw > 0.001 and an economic meter cap of the plan binds (−net = cap − expected load within 0.001 MW; action_cap names it: cmd or ircr); 'discharge' if > 0.001 otherwise; 'hold' else (no planned energy; FCESS stays enabled, see fcess_mw, and expected regulation-raise use still lowers the stored energy)
plan.value_at_forecast_aud: record energy_value, fcess_value, stored_value (stored_end: energy left at 08:00 next day at the plan's end value), money (net); derived: wear = record wear − (money − value) = A$30 × planned discharge MWh; regulation_energy = value − (energy + fcess − record wear + stored_end). net = energy + regulation_energy + fcess − wear + stored_end, from 09:00. Not comparable with outcome.money_aud.net (that has no stored_end and includes the network saving)

offers_0900.file: analysis/2026-10-26/power_cap_fix/out_offers/rtms_2026-02-02_0900.json (made by analysis/2026-10-26/power_cap_fix/run_offers.py for G5B = e5 with Gate Closure lock)
offers_0900.check: regenerated here from the e5 replay with vpp.v2.offers.Collector: every DI's energy tranches identical (identical_to_e5_replay)
offers_0900.by_halfhour: per half-hour, the injection tranches above the plan (every positive tranche except the planned discharge at −999.99) of the DIs in the submission; per price: mw = mean over those DIs (0 where a DI has no tranche at that price), mw_min/mw_max, dis_with_tranche. Prices are the real thresholds (whole cents); 'MAX' = the month's Energy Offer Price Ceiling. When the plan charges, the planned charging is bid at one cent below the first sell tranche (not listed)
offers_0900.protected_mwh: derived: stored MWh at the start of each half-hour (the 09:00 plan's) in value segments whose threshold (LadderBids.thresholds with the 09:00 offers' inputs) is at or above the month's ceiling, i.e. offered only at MAX. On both days this equals protected_mwh_model rounded up to whole 1 MWh segments (LadderBids marks a segment protected if its bottom is below the protected level). protected_mwh_model = min(LadderBids.protect, stored): the factory's energy for today's caps and tomorrow's needs (vpp.v2.bids.protection), from 09:00. Within one 5-min DI the battery can sell only ~0.9 MWh, so MAX tranches appear in a DI only when the protected level is that close to the stored energy

outcome.battery_mw: run_day log energy_mwh / 0.5 h (includes regulation energy)
outcome.soc_mwh: log soc_start then soc (end of each half-hour)
outcome.offer_cleared_mw: derived from the 5-min steps (run_day on_step): max(0, min(executed MW, MW after the offer) − max(plan MW, 0)) where the layered offer sold, averaged over the half-hour; the plan is the one in force at the step (re-planned every half-hour), not the 09:00 plan; the backtest's offers are priced from the latest 5-min price, not locked at 09:00
outcome.money_aud: energy, fcess, wear, market_net: run_day summary = after_ledger.csv; network: after_bills.csv saving / days of the month; net = energy + fcess − wear + network = after_money.csv (vpp.stochastic.daily_money)
